question: In a certain code language, 'RESTRICT' is written as 'CTRISTRE', 'STARTING' is written as 'NGTIARST' and 'MOUNTAIN' is written as 'INTAUNMO'. What is the code for the word 'ENVELOPE' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• All pairs are rearranged in diagonally.
 
• The order of the letters within the pair remains the same.

So,

 
• RESTRICT is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/845c1fc71b68b6b823e3fb193ecb931edcb8c043d517e8c00e41c52c71eea461.png] 

 STARTING is written as :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be900b86da6be47a596a0fc72c8f054283aefac95376bc956e8e5989bb737c45.png] 

 
• MOUNTAIN is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b22d67a6895c23d44ce3bc20dc3655169db74b69e37c0c1824efe1d3f31385d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ENVELOPE is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdab88c0afc01d8b32251bfd4e1115c0a0e031a83be27df6605942751d68f71e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**PELOVEEN**".
